body:
Replace the Tasks tab's Project, Feature and Milestone select boxes with text inputs that act as comboboxes. Typing shows suggestions from the loaded records: case-insensitive substring matches in the project label or folder, feature title or id, and milestone title or id, with prefix matches first and then by title. Choosing a suggestion applies the same filter id the select sent; clearing the input means All.

The current choice's title/label fills the input and is marked in the list. While text is typed but no suggestion is chosen, keep the current filter. Support click, Up/Down, Enter and Escape, with combobox/listbox roles and `aria-activedescendant`. Matching is literal substring, not typo-tolerant edit distance; no suggestions is a clear empty state.

**Tests:** matching and ordering for each filter; choosing, clearing and no-match behavior; keyboard navigation; duplicate titles remain distinct by id; the task query still combines with all three filters.
title: tasks: filters suggest as typed
